run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the googlemock group cc'd
run_main_with_cc_flag: run main to invoke upload.py with --cc=googlemock@googlegroups.com automatically added to the cc line
run_main_without_cc_flag: run main to invoke upload.py and append --cc=googlemock@googlegroups.com when no cc flag is provided
review_main_cc_parsing: review the main function logic that parses existing --cc flags and deduplicates email addresses
review_execv_invocation: review how os.execv replaces the current process with upload.py using modified command line arguments
